algorithm: Sort unique game dates chronologically; G distinct dates
For each replicate, draw G date indices uniformly with replacement
Use the SAME date draw for log-loss and Brier paired differences
Retain every game within each sampled date; repeat whole date cluster according to its draw multiplicity
Replicate mean = sum of sampled cluster paired-loss sums / sum of sampled cluster game counts; do not average daily means
Do not refit, recompute features, shuffle within chronology or resample independent games
cluster: calendar date; normalized date already used by frozen pregame contract
interpretation: Approximate descriptive intervals only. Date clustering does not remove across-date/team dependence; no formal independence-adjusted significance claim, no p-value, no tuning.
interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of replicate means, numpy.quantile(method="linear")
invalid_input: Reject missing/nonfinite loss differences or dates, duplicate game keys, or fewer than two date clusters; stop and disclose, no post-opening method substitution
log_loss: Use exactly frozen metrics.py EPSILON clipping (1e-15), natural logs
multiplicity: Two predeclared primary losses, no multiplicity-adjusted significance claim
point_statistics: arithmetic mean of all per-game paired differences
median of all per-game paired differences
25th and 75th percentiles of per-game paired differences
rng: numpy.random.default_rng(0), PCG64; dependency version pinned by final freeze
standard_error: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the 10000 replicate means, labeled descriptive date-clustered bootstrap SE
